purpose: M14-PRE-SQUADS: the exact Squads v4 program bytes that run on Solana devnet, for local LiteSVM compatibility checks. Read-only fetch; nothing was sent to any cluster.

elf.length_rule: ELF64-LE end = max(e_shoff + e_shnum*e_shentsize, max(p_offset+p_filesz over program headers), max(sh_offset+sh_size over non-NOBITS sections)); the three agree up to the section header table, which is the last thing in the file

packet_cross_check.note: The packet's 'trimmed' hash was taken after stripping every trailing zero byte (794,655), which also removes 15 zero bytes that belong to the ELF itself; the section-table rule keeps those, so squads-devnet.so hashes differently from the packet's trimmed value while the full payload hash is identical.

idl.source: devnet on-chain Anchor IDL account 6i4UjrDtkc7dqEmCyNDRfoxnAhDKSrY92u96Z74nRFdX (PDA seed 'anchor:idl' from the program's base PDA), read-only getAccountInfo at slot 514487136; layout 8-byte discriminator | 32-byte authority | u32 data_len | zlib stream
idl.note: Anchor instruction discriminators are sha256('global:<snake_case name>')[..8]; this old-format IDL carries none, so the harness derives them and the compile/run results are the check.

reproduce: curl -s https://api.devnet.solana.com -H 'content-type: application/json' -d '{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"getAccountInfo","params":["Fy3YMJCvwbAXUgUM5b91ucUVA3jYzwWLHL3MwBqKsh8n",{"encoding":"base64","commitment":"finalized"}]}'; base64-decode result.value.data[0]; drop the 45-byte header; keep elf_len bytes where elf_len is computed by the length_rule.
limits: A read-only snapshot of bytes: not a deployment, a liveness receipt, or an audit of Squads.

recheck_unchanged.note: Same read-only getAccountInfo repeated about 6,200 slots after the first fetch: the ProgramData account data hash is identical.
